paper_title: Interpretable Operator Learning for Inverse Problems via Adaptive Spectral Filtering: Convergence and Discretization Invariance

criteria.name: convergence_order_paper_grid
criteria.description: Fitted order of SC-Net on the paper's noise grid is within 0.05 of s/(s+p)=0.5

criteria.name: convergence_order_asymptotic
criteria.description: Fitted order on the extended grid (delta down to 1e-8) is within 0.02 of 0.5

criteria.name: zero_shot_error_magnitude
criteria.description: Zero-shot error at N=2048 matches the paper's 0.2292 within 15%

criteria.name: zero_shot_stability
criteria.description: Error drifts by <5% from the N=256 training grid to N=2048

criteria.name: zero_shot_stability_full_aperture
criteria.description: With the aperture widened to all 2048 modes, the error still drifts by <15%

criteria.name: beats_oracle_tikhonov
criteria.description: SC-Net beats Oracle Tikhonov at every noise level on the suite

criteria.name: beats_oracle_tikhonov_margin
criteria.description: Worst-case relative margin over Oracle Tikhonov across noise levels

criteria.name: filter_is_interpretable
criteria.description: Learned filter is a bounded damping profile in [0,1] that can be tabulated

criteria.name: filter_preserves_low_modes
criteria.description: Learned damping exceeds 0.9 on the leading mode at every noise level

criteria.name: filter_suppresses_high_modes
criteria.description: Learned damping is below 0.05 at mode 32 at every noise level

criteria.name: filter_sharper_than_tikhonov
criteria.description: Learned transition band is narrower than Tikhonov's at every noise level
